items.title: Johnny DeDroit Interview, 1973-03-16
items.q: I'd get Albert Curse, who was one of our fine, and I'd let him play the rock in the microphone

ctx.x: Do you think that had a lot to do with the fact that they had the carnival here? Do you think that has a lot to do with the fact that you had so much music in New Orleans because you had a big call for

the dance bands? During the carnival season, we sometimes had to engage men from the symphony, if they were available. There's always a shortage of men during the carnival season. Yes. And then some of them like big orchestras, you know, and some don't. But they like to make a splash, you know, or the captain does anyhow. And if you can talk, you've got a good line. For instance, if it was too light a ball and I had solos, like I told you, if we had played balls, bluett or something like that, I'd get Albert…
You know how I used to- What years was this now, you're talking about all these four trumpets and three trombones?
